project_critical_path.objective: Run a nondestructive representative private sweep across multiple restored manuscripts to test diagnostic breadth, uncertainty, preservation and cross-book voice separation using existing Passage Intelligence, specialist diagnostics, opportunity admission and Step-K defenses.
initial_sources: Unhindered_Book_3.docx — authoritative signal: CANONICAL MASTERED v2
Unhindered-Book_4.docx — high-maturity EDITOR-READY sample, no canon inference
One or more Moses volumes as noncanon diagnostic-generalization stress only because version authority remains UNKNOWN
comparison_controls: Unhindered Books 1-2 remain non-authoritative developmental trajectory/stress controls only.
AGLO remains a separately qualified real-book control and must not dominate cross-book voice targets.
project_critical_path.exact_gate: For each selected manuscript, build private passage states and diagnostic findings; persist only digests/nonreconstructive metrics; prove findings are conditioned by book/local purpose and authority; prove uncertain findings abstain; prove no cross-book style convergence; generate no revision candidate unless a bounded opportunity has sufficient expected gain and preservation safety.
project_critical_path.pass_proves: The Prose Project's diagnostic intelligence generalizes beyond AGLO across distinct real manuscripts without confusing maturity states, canon authority or book-specific voice.
project_critical_path.pass_unlocks: A ranked, evidence-backed Prose mastery gap list based on real multi-book behavior rather than a single manuscript or synthetic taxonomy, followed by the smallest concrete diagnostic/prose improvement tranche.
project_critical_path.on_failure: Repair only the exposed diagnostic, authority, preservation, abstention or homogenization boundary. Do not rewrite manuscripts or create a universal style target.

a01_next.reason: Representative private diagnostic analysis is dependency-valid and does not yet require a new self-hosted exact-SHA milestone gate.
